audit_items.proof_trace: When a new obligation joins after a pool reward has started, `earned_rewards` is explicitly set to `float::from(0)` (L376) and `cumulative_rewards_per_share` is snapshotted to the current pool index (L379), ensuring future reward computations only count the delta from join time onward. Since all new obligations start with `share = 0` (L201), even if time passes between creation and the first deposit call, `new_rewards = delta * 0 = 0`, providing a belt-and-suspenders guard against retroactive reward claims.
